commentary.text: 90+15' Sascha Stegemann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+15' A big opportunity is wasted by Jakov Medic (Bochum), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Kevin Muller pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
90+11' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+11' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
90+10' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+10' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) got in a good shooting position on the edge of the box and pulled the trigger. The ball flew towards the top right corner, but Timo Horn punched it onto the post. The ball goes behind for a corner. Heidenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+9' Heidenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
90+7' Dieter Hecking has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani de Wit (Bochum) replacing Maximilian Wittek.
90+7' The referee signals a substitution. Jakov Medic (Bochum) is brought on as a substitute for Ivan Ordets.
90+6' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Timo Horn stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
90+5' The Bochum players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+3' Myron Boadu (Bochum) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
90+2' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' The ball rebounds to Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.

88' Bochum slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
87' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.

77' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

77' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Heidenheim.
76' The ball is laid off to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Timo Horn to make a decent save.

73' Close! Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
71' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
70' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
67' Some neat passing and movement from Bochum as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

66' OFF THE POST! Myron Boadu (Bochum) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

45+1' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post.

28' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

26' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' Felix Passlack (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
24' Tom Krauss (Bochum) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
22' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Heidenheim.
21' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
19' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

15' Heidenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

11' The foul by Myron Boadu (Bochum) was seen by Sascha Stegemann who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

8' Felix Passlack (Bochum) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

5' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Kevin Muller easily deals with the threat.
4' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
